title: Screen paint: a pointer field without a fluid solver
summary: Quarter-res capsule-stroke paint field, self-advected along a 1/16 blurred copy with gradient-noise curl, read by a 9-tap smear with an oil-film fringe
variants: As a pass in a larger post queue: run the paint once a frame and let any pass sample it (distortion here; a reveal mask or a light map elsewhere)
OGL: the same three passes with ogl RenderTargets
